purpose: User-approved bounded diagnosis of availability, patient detail and manual appointment creation, before spending or changing platform.
data: One owned capacity-01 practice using unchanged deterministic seed:6000patients/12000appointments. This matches per-practice volume, not the two-practice acceptance scenario. Other19practices preserved.
budget: Before seed current physical DB plus50000000bytes must remain below300000000bytes, same per-practice safety allowance as existing seeder. No altered provider limits or paid resources.
observations: Bounded direct SQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE with actual roles/claims and guards on owned fixture; read probes read-only, atomic creation probes rollback.
Bounded sequential HTTP calls through real application and direct REST API, one login, normalized operation labels only, no response bodies/credentials/clinical data persisted.
Record connection/client wall separately from server SQL execution; no unpaired timing subtraction represented as exact server CPU.
At most3real owned HTTP creations; unchanged tested cleanup removes only owned deterministic fixture. No documents, push subscription or OAuth consent.
hypotheses: A specific SQL plan or repeated rule dominates one target operation; establish with actual plan/loops/timing before changes.
Several serial HTTP roundtrips materially contribute despite bounded SQL work; compare role-correct component timings without inventing exact cross-request attribution.
Shared backend waits produce intermittent multi-operation stalls; isolated fast samples cannot disprove historical contention or certify capacity.
stopRules: No repeated48min load. Stop provider mutations on unexpected identity/ownership, cross-practice data, storage side effects or budget violation. Do not weaken RLS, concurrency, idempotency or acceptance thresholds.
cleanup: Unchanged guarded cleanup-practices.sql plus removeCapacityOwners(practices=1); exact preexisting counts readback, temporary local secret removed after cleanup; no Actions secret created.
acceptance: Diagnostic only. Any code defect gets a failing regression before correction. Full load may run later only after justified change, while keeping prior failures.
